    output-file: radar-age-profiles-tarragones.generated.md
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false

unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: r
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - _practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/poblacio-edat-tarragones-2021.csv
  outputs:
    - assets/img/data-visualization/radar-age-profiles-tarragones-2021.svg
---

```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

county <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/poblacio-edat-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

municipalities <- c("Pobla de Mafumet, la", "Vila-seca", "Creixell")
county <- county[
  county$YEAR == 2021 &
    county$CONCEPT == "POP" &
    county$SEX == "TOTAL" &
    county$AGE != "TOTAL" &
    county$municipality_name %in% municipalities &
    !is.na(county$value),
]

county$age_years <- ifelse(
  county$AGE == "Y_GE100",
  100L,
  as.integer(substring(county$AGE, 2))
)
county$age_group <- cut(
  county$age_years,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 14, 29, 44, 64, Inf),
  right = TRUE,
  labels = c("0-14", "15-29", "30-44", "45-64", "65+")
)

profiles <- aggregate(
  value ~ municipality_name + age_group,
  data = county,
  FUN = sum
)
totals <- aggregate(value ~ municipality_name, data = county, FUN = sum)
profiles <- merge(profiles, totals, by = "municipality_name", suffixes = c("", "_total"))
profiles$pct <- 100 * profiles$value / profiles$value_total

profile_totals <- aggregate(pct ~ municipality_name, data = profiles, FUN = sum)
stopifnot(
  nrow(profiles) == length(municipalities) * 5,
  all(abs(profile_totals$pct - 100) < 1e-6),
  max(profiles$pct) < 40
)

display_names <- c(
  "Pobla de Mafumet, la" = "La Pobla de Mafumet",
  "Vila-seca" = "Vila-seca",
  "Creixell" = "Creixell"
)
profiles$municipality <- factor(
  unname(display_names[profiles$municipality_name]),
  levels = unname(display_names[municipalities])
)
profiles$age_group <- factor(
  profiles$age_group,
  levels = c("0-14", "15-29", "30-44", "45-64", "65+")
)
profiles$axis <- as.integer(profiles$age_group)
angles <- pi / 2 - (0:4) * 2 * pi / 5
profiles$x <- profiles$pct * cos(angles[profiles$axis])
profiles$y <- profiles$pct * sin(angles[profiles$axis])

profile_xy <- profiles[order(profiles$municipality, profiles$axis), ]
profile_xy <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(split(profile_xy, profile_xy$municipality), function(x) rbind(x, x[1, ]))
)

grid_xy <- expand.grid(ring = c(10, 20, 30, 40), axis = 1:5)
grid_xy$x <- grid_xy$ring * cos(angles[grid_xy$axis])
grid_xy$y <- grid_xy$ring * sin(angles[grid_xy$axis])
grid_xy <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(split(grid_xy, grid_xy$ring), function(x) rbind(x, x[1, ]))
)

axes <- data.frame(
  x = 0,
  y = 0,
  xend = 40 * cos(angles),
  yend = 40 * sin(angles)
)
axis_labels <- data.frame(
  x = 45 * cos(angles),
  y = 45 * sin(angles),
  label = levels(profiles$age_group),
  hjust = ifelse(cos(angles) > 0.1, 0, ifelse(cos(angles) < -0.1, 1, 0.5))
)
ring_labels <- data.frame(
  municipality = factor("La Pobla de Mafumet", levels = levels(profiles$municipality)),
  x = c(10, 20, 30, 40) * cos(pi / 2 + 0.08),
  y = c(10, 20, 30, 40) * sin(pi / 2 + 0.08),
  label = paste0(c(10, 20, 30, 40), "%")
)

palette <- c(
  "La Pobla de Mafumet" = "#0072B2",
  "Vila-seca" = "#D55E00",
  "Creixell" = "#009E73"
)

fig <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = grid_xy,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = ring),
    fill = NA,
    color = "#dce3e9",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = axes,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    color = "#cbd5df",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = profile_xy,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = municipality, fill = municipality),
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.16
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = profile_xy,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = municipality, color = municipality),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = profiles,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = municipality),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = axis_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
    color = "#17202a",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ring_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    color = "#667784",
    hjust = 1.1,
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~municipality, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-49, 49), ylim = c(-49, 49), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Perfils d'edat de tres municipis del Tarragonès (2021)",
    subtitle = "Percentatge de la població municipal en cada grup; escala radial comuna del 0 al 40%",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Font: Idescat, cens de 2021. Cada perfil suma el 100%; l'àrea del polígon no representa cap estadística."
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#52616b", size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#52616b", size = 8, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 9)),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 14, 8, 10)
  )

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/radar-age-profiles-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 10, height = 4.6, device = svglite::svglite)
```
